text:
For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB memory, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5/i7 chip. That mix runs code editors, Docker and a few browser tabs smoothly.

What to look for:

Memory: 16 GB at minimum. 8 GB feels slow fast, so prefer one where you can upgrade later.
Screen: 14 to 15.6 inch, full HD, IPS, 300 nits or brighter. You'll stare at text all day.
Keyboard and battery: try the keyboard in a shop if you can, and look for 8+ hours of real use.
Graphics: skip a dedicated card unless you'll train AI or build games. That money is better spent on memory and build quality.

I haven't checked live prices, so I can't name exact laptops yet. Do you mostly code for web and apps, or for AI work? Tell me that and which system you prefer (Windows, Linux or Mac), and I can look up current options.
